overview.description: The Main Sector Rotation ETF (SECT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that uses fundamental analysis to pursue a sector rotation strategy. The fund aims to outperform the S&P 500 while limiting losses during periods of decline, and may hold equities of any market cap or geographic exposure. SECT was launched on Sep 5, 2017 and is issued by Main Management.
